_read_me: The ONE file to edit. Change only the text between the quotes (keep the quotes and the commas), then run: python agency/storefront/build.py . The first five keys (agency_name, city, phone, email, brand_color) are the shared ones: when agency/config.json exists, its values win, so one edit there updates the storefront, the pitches and the demo sites.
_brand_color: coral (warm red), ocean (blue), forest (green), or your own color like #1E6B47. Preview a preset by adding ?preset=ocean to a page address.
service_area: YOUR CITY and the towns around it
_booking_url: Your free Cal.com or Calendly link, for example https://cal.com/yourname/15min . Empty = the Book buttons open the contact form.
_site_url: Your web address once you have one, for example https://youragency.com (share previews and the sitemap use it).

offer.headline: Websites that make your phone *ring*.

offer.guarantee: We build a free demo of your new website first. If you don't love it, you pay nothing.

faq.q: How much does a website cost?
faq.a: Plans start at {from_setup} to build, then {from_monthly} a month for hosting, security, backups and your edits. No hidden fees.

faq.q: Can I see my website before I pay?
faq.a: Yes. We build a free demo of your new site first, usually within {demo_days} days. If you don't love it, you pay nothing.

faq.q: How long until my site is live?
faq.a: Most sites go live within {launch_days} days of your OK on the demo.

faq.q: I already have a website. Can you redo it?
faq.a: Yes. We keep what works (your domain, your good photos, your reviews) and rebuild the rest so it loads fast and works on phones.

faq.q: What does the monthly fee cover?
faq.a: Hosting, the padlock (SSL), daily backups, security updates, uptime checks and the edits in your plan. If something breaks, we fix it.

faq.q: Do I own my website and my domain?
faq.a: Your domain is registered in your name, and your words and photos are yours. If you ever leave, we hand you a copy of your site.
No long contract. After launch your plan is month to month, and you can cancel with 30 days' notice.

faq.q: Will I show up first on Google?
faq.a: We set up everything Google looks for: fast pages, the right titles, your town and your services, and a properly filled-in Google Business Profile. Nobody can honestly promise the number one spot, so we won't.

faq.q: Do I have to write the text or take photos?
faq.a: No. We write the words with you on a short call. Photos from your phone are perfect, and we tell you exactly what to snap.
Text or email us what to change. Small edits are usually done {reply_time}.

faq.q: What kinds of businesses do you work with?
faq.a: Local businesses that live on calls and bookings: barbers and salons, plumbers, electricians, heating and air, cleaners, landscapers, auto shops, restaurants and cafes.
In {city}. We meet in person or on a quick call, whichever is easier for you.

_testimonials: Only real reviews, with the customer's OK: {"quote": "...", "name": "Maria G.", "business": "Maria's Bakery"}. Empty = the section stays hidden.
